claims: Power is a Starz crime drama.
Power's final season premiered on August 25, 2019.
Power focuses on James "Ghost" St. Patrick's double life as a nightclub owner and drug kingpin.
The premise of Power is that a NYC drug kingpin attempts to leave the criminal world for a legitimate life, balancing his high-end nightclub business with a violent drug network.
Ghost is a spin-off of the Power franchise.
Raising Kanan is a spin-off of the Power franchise.
Force is a spin-off of the Power franchise.
Origins is a spin-off of the Power franchise.
Power is executive produced by Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson.
Power was created by Courtney Kemp Agboh.
